//: Acknowledgements that a counted architecture file changed WITHOUT the census being re-measured. Read by src/scripts/checkCensusFreshness.ts. An entry names the census, the head_commit it was written against (`since`), the FILES it covers, and why those changes cannot have moved a verdict. It covers the paths it names and nothing else — a counted file that changed and is not listed in `files` makes the census stale again, and an entry with no `files` covers nothing. It is spent the moment that census is re-measured: the checker compares `since` against the census head_commit and FAILS on a mismatch, so an acknowledgement cannot outlive the measurement it was written for.

acknowledged.reason:

NO section-18 or section-15 requirement changes built/not-built status: nothing was added, nothing was removed, one function changed file.
